installHintBody: After tapping Install in the system dialog, return to the home screen to watch the download progress. The system replaces the current version automatically once the download finishes.
openInstallFailedBody: Copy the install address manually and open it in Safari.
bundleAvailableBody: A new version is available. Download and install the full app package to update.
upToDateBody: You already have the latest app package.
checkFailedBody: Couldn't reach the update server. Try again later.

lex.installHint: Android will ask you to confirm installation. Your accounts and local data are retained.
lex.permissionHint: Allow Lex to install unknown apps in system settings, then return and tap Install update.
lex.betaHint: Receive RC and other test versions. Turning this off waits for a newer stable release; it does not downgrade.
lex.attribution: Lex is an independent community distribution based on Cindy. Cindy accounts and online services are provided by Cindy.
lex.manualHint: In-app installation is unavailable on this platform or build. Use the downloads page for supported packages.
lex.linkFailed: Could not open the link. Check your browser settings.

phases.idle: Checks automatically; downloads only when you tap.
phases.current: No newer version is available on this channel.
phases.unpublished: No Android update manifest has been published on this channel.
phases.downloading: Downloading. Closing the app may interrupt it; retry starts a fresh download.
phases.downloaded: Downloaded and verified. Ready to install.
phases.installing: Verifying again and opening the system installer…
phases.permission-required: Installation permission is needed. Return after allowing it.
phases.installer-opened: System installer opened. Confirm installation there; the upgrade is not yet confirmed.
phases.error: Update did not finish. You can retry.

errors.SIGNATURE_MISMATCH: Package identity or signature does not match. Installation stopped. Get the correct package from Lex releases.
errors.WRONG_PACKAGE: Package identity or signature does not match. Installation stopped. Get the correct package from Lex releases.
errors.WRONG_VERSION: Package identity or signature does not match. Installation stopped. Get the correct package from Lex releases.
errors.CHECKSUM_MISMATCH: The package is incomplete or failed verification. Download it again.
errors.SIZE_MISMATCH: The package is incomplete or failed verification. Download it again.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Not enough writable storage. Free up space and retry.
errors.INVALID_METADATA: Invalid update manifest. Retry later or visit Lex releases.
errors.NETWORK_OR_INSTALL_FAILED: The update request or system installer failed. Check your connection and installation permission, then retry.
